Waiting for the kettle? Try this.

Feel your feet on the floor.
Name three sounds you can hear.
Let one breath out be slower than the one in.

That's about a minute. The kettle never minds. 💜✨

Some days you have no time to write much. Keep one question by your pen and answer it in two sentences.

What did I do today that my future self will quietly thank me for?

Small things count here. A glass of water counts. 🌟

Scripting is not lying to yourself.
It's a rehearsal.

Write one ordinary morning as if your goal were already part of it. Notice what you wear, what you say, how your shoulders feel.

Then pick one small step that scene shows you. 🔮💫
